$schema_note: MCP server manifest for ~/.claude. Registers servers used by literature-check agent, /cite-add command, and future R3-2b OSF integration. Tokens NEVER inlined here — always file-referenced via env vars. Activate per-machine via `claude mcp add-json <server-name> '{...}'` referencing the entries below, or via `claude mcp add` interactively.

crossref.$source: github.com/h-lu/crossref-cite-mcp. Verified 2026-05-15. Set CROSSREF_MAILTO to your contact email for the polite pool (CrossRef gives higher rate limits to identified users).
crossref.$tools_note: Resolve DOI -> CSL-JSON / BibTeX / RIS / formatted text. Consumed by /cite-add slash command (R1-C).

zenodo.$status: no canonical MCP server exists as of 2026-05-15
zenodo.$workaround: Use the generic mcp-server-fetch (https://pypi.org/project/mcp-server-fetch/) against https://zenodo.org/api/ until a dedicated server lands. Auth via OAuth Bearer token from ~/.config/zenodo/token (never inline). Required for R3-2b OSF pre-reg integration and rules/publishing.md Zenodo DOI minting.
zenodo.$followup: Re-evaluate at next dotfiles refresh; track modelcontextprotocol/servers community for a Zenodo addition.
